semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Zeal Clean Supplies provides essential packaging solutions that protect semiconductor components from contamination, crucial for maintaining manufacturing integrity.
summary: Zeal Clean Supplies manufactures high-purity flexible packaging solutions specifically for the semiconductor industry. Their products, including LDPE film, cleanantistatic LDPE, moisture barrier bags, and ESD bags, are designed to protect sensitive semiconductor components during handling and storage, ensuring contamination-free manufacturing processes.
capabilities: High-purity LDPE film for semiconductor applications
